scheme_name: Immediate Assistance in Case of Accident to the Beneficiary
other_conditions: The construction worker must be registered under the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board
The construction worker must not be covered by the Group Insurance Scheme undertaken by the Board
For accidental death, the applicant must be the nominee/dependent of the deceased construction worker
For disability benefit, the worker must be disabled due to an accident
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for hospitalization, disability, and accidental death to registered construction workers.
